name: MinePacks
author: GeorgH93
description: Minepacks is a backpack plugin with different backpack sizes, multilanguage and MySQL storage support. It is a simple plugin, but still has a lot of functions.

permissions.name: backpack.*
permissions.description: Gives access to the full MinePacks functionality.

permissions.name: backpack.use
permissions.description: Allows a player to open the backpack.

permissions.name: backpack
permissions.description: Allows a player to open the backpack.

permissions.name: backpack.size.1
permissions.description: Mini size for a backpack, if the player has backpack permission he will also have at least a backpack with the size 1.

permissions.name: backpack.clean
permissions.description: Allows the player to clean their own backpack.

permissions.name: backpack.clean.other
permissions.description: Allows the player to clean other players backpacks.

permissions.name: backpack.others
permissions.description: Allows the player open backpacks of other players.

permissions.name: backpack.others.edit
permissions.description: Allows the player to edit backpacks of other players.

permissions.name: backpack.KeepOnDeath
permissions.description: Allows the player to keep their items in their backpack on death.

permissions.name: backpack.noCooldown
permissions.description: Allows to bypass the cooldown to open the backpack.
